text_block_list.text:
The morning of the final day of summer 
camp has arrived.

It happened just as the Umamusume were 
boarding the bus to return to the academy.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And yet, there's so little time left until 
the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!? That's right! I am the first-rate 
Umamusume, King Halo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, why are you starting a chant?! 
Don't put me on the spot like this?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, don't take your jokes too far. 
We don't have that kind of leeway.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Once this summer is over, it will be here 
in no time. ...The final race of the 
Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A long-distance 3000m turf race. Even so, 
I will without fail—...

"...And on the bus ride back to the 
academy, she gazed out the window as if 
lost in thought."
